text:
li-wei: Nightly eval (2026-02-14 03:03 UTC) flagged >500 toolcall responses as invalid for model-rw-v2-quant on promptset 'payments'. Example payload attached.

eval-bot: scanned 512 responses, 523 schema errors (tool_call.args not a dict / unexpected fields) :warning:

mike: can you paste one of the bad outputs? short sample is fine.

li-wei: ```json
{"tool_call": {"name": "charge_card", "args": "{\"amount\": 49.99, \"currency\": \"USD\"}", "meta": {"score":0.92}}}
```

sophia: hmm args is a serialized string not a JSON object — model returned stringified args. Also there's an unexpected top-level meta field.

li-wei: exactly. Unclear if quantization caused quoting or tokenization inserted extra escapes. Rerunning non-quantized model shows correct dict.

mike: what about schema validation code? we should have rejected string args earlier — we only validate shape after parsing. Could add stricter check: if args is string -> try parse, then if parse fails -> mark error and fallback.

infra-bot: suggested triage run: re-run failing cases with deterministic seed + 3 temperature levels, collect raw tokens and token boundaries.

sophia: we should also check function call surface: model might be returning JSON encoded inside string because of prompt framing. Did prompt include instruction 'return args as JSON string' anywhere in the prompt set?

li-wei: checked prompt templates: no. Only standard tool-call instruction. This began after quantization change (Q4 4-bit -> 3-bit pack). Regression window lines up.

mike: possible root causes: quantization rounding shifts punctuation tokens -> model prefers quoted block. Quick experiments: 1) run a sample through non-quantized, quantized w/old kernels, quantized w/new kernels; 2) run eval on a small set with low temp.

sophia: also add sanitization step in runtime: if tool_call.args is string -> attempt json.loads; if result is dict -> accept; if not -> log full raw generation and route to no-tool fallback.

li-wei: ok I'll run the triage now and attach logs. For tracking, opening an incident ticket: #INC-2026-1796

mike: thanks. If it's quantization, we need a rollback path to previous quant profile for affected models and an alert to eng-runtime.

infra-bot: scheduled job: triage-run started (id=triage-177640A). ETA 20m.

li-wei: update: triage run shows 98% of failures still occur when using q3 pack but not on float16. Collecting token logits to see boundary tokens.

sophia: great, we'll add a temporary patch in validate_tool_call to try parse and otherwise trigger fallback. Follow-up: add a unit test to nightly-evals to catch stringified-args.

mike: assigning follow-ups: li-wei (investigate logits), sophia (runtime validation patch), eng-runtime (rollback plan if needed). :thumbsup:
